criteria.name: Identity and site
criteria.evidence: Archived Purdue ArcGIS BuildingShapesZip4 feature FID 765 identifies SOACO / Alpha Chi Omega at 851 David Ross Rd. The recorded origin (-1081.0865435, 817.2396546) m matches the source polygon centroid using the repository's documented local approximation.

criteria.name: Footprint and form
criteria.evidence: The detailed shell and foundation follow the official FID 765 GIS polygon after removal of sub-0.08 m snap segments. The GIS/massing overlay supports choosing this polygon over the divergent rough massing candidate. Site coordinates remain an approximate local transform rather than survey-grade positioning.

criteria.name: Facade and material fidelity
criteria.evidence: Compared with R1, the candidate render now shows three unmistakable semicircular entrance bays, thicker pale supports, a balcony/rail directly above them, and narrower taller roof dormers. Red brick, dark roof, central gable/sign, limestone trim, chimney, and three visible window levels correspond to the chapter-owned 2016 rendering. Remaining difference: the roof still reads as a very broad, high hipped/mansard cap with a wide flat upper plane, and its overall roof-to-wall proportion is larger than the reference; the reference has a more compact, steep dormered roof and more prominent upper facade/balcony. Six modeled dormers also do not match the denser source rhythm exactly.

criteria.name: Interior
criteria.evidence: The evidence continues to label floor plates, corridor bars, and basement common/dining furniture as schematic and nondimensional. No georegisterable or dimensioned plan was found, so the model does not establish room layout or interior dimensions.

criteria.name: Portability and fresh-open validation
criteria.evidence: The exact file SHA matches the requested R2 revision. Fresh-open validation reports the expected scene and export collection, 834 objects / 832 meshes, and no external file images, image texture nodes, or linked Blender libraries.

findings.finding: Roof cap remains broader and visually heavier than the chapter rendering, despite the more legible sloped mansard band and taller dormers.
findings.recommended_fix: If another refinement is warranted, reduce the flat upper plane and overall roof mass, increase the steep mansard shoulder, and tune the dormer count/spacing against the source image. Retain height labels as estimates unless new evidence supports measured values.

findings.finding: Interior layout and dimensions remain unverified.
findings.recommended_fix: Continue to label the interior schematic unless a dimensioned or georegisterable plan becomes available.
